items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: We had another -- we had a bass player by the name of Nelson Boyd.

ctx.x: Who else was in that band?

Well, Shadow Wilson was in the band and Billy Taylor was in the band. We had another -- we had a bass player by the name of Nelson Boyd. Hawk also liked to play in difficult keys. So we were going to play this tune Small Hotel, and Hawk said, well, he said, John let's play it

in A natural. Said fine. So Nelson Boyd said what key did you say we were going to play in, Hawk. Hawk, said, doesn't make any difference, Nelson, you're going to play the same notes, whatever key. Oh. But Hawk could play in all keys and he loved to do it. That was a great band.
